nodes.name: RedisCache.java
nodes.summary: Core Redis abstraction interface of the redis framework, declaring ~129 cache operations (strings, hashes, lists, sets, Lua script execution, TTL queries) used by every service for high-concurrency caching.
nodes.languageNotes: Large Java interface with extensive generic method overloading parameterized by RedisKeyBuild for type-safe key construction.

nodes.name: RedisCache
nodes.summary: Interface defining the full Redis operation surface (get/put for values, lists, hashes, expirations, distributed Lua execution) consumed across all microservices.

nodes.name: ProgramClient.java
nodes.summary: OpenFeign client interface for the program-service, exposing the ticket-category list query endpoint with a configured fallback.

nodes.name: ProgramClient
nodes.summary: Feign interface declaring the remote selectListByProgram call that returns ticket categories for a program.

nodes.name: ProgramClientFallback.java
nodes.summary: Feign fallback implementation for ProgramClient that returns a SYSTEM_ERROR ApiResponse when the program-service call fails.

nodes.name: ProgramClientFallback
nodes.summary: Circuit-breaker fallback for the program-service Feign client, returning an error response instead of propagating the failure.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryAddDto.java
nodes.summary: DTO carrying fields required to add a new ticket category (program id, name, price, totals) to the program-service.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryAddDto
nodes.summary: Request model for creating a ticket category, validated with JSR-303 annotations.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryDto.java
nodes.summary: DTO used to query the detail of a single ticket category by id.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryDto
nodes.summary: Request model wrapping a ticket category id for detail lookups.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryListByProgramDto.java
nodes.summary: DTO used to request the list of ticket categories belonging to a given program id.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryListByProgramDto
nodes.summary: Request model wrapping a program id for ticket-category list queries, shared between the Feign client and the controller.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryDetailVo.java
nodes.summary: View object exposing full ticket category detail (price, total and remaining numbers, timestamps) to API consumers.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryDetailVo
nodes.summary: Detailed ticket category response model including remaining stock, serialized with date format annotations.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryVo.java
nodes.summary: View object representing a ticket category in list views (id, program id, name, price, totals) cached in Redis and Caffeine.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryVo
nodes.summary: Ticket category list-item response model used by the multi-level (local + Redis) cache in the program-service.

nodes.name: ApiRestrictData.java
nodes.summary: Data holder for gateway API rate-limit results parsed from the Lua script response (trigger status and message).

nodes.name: ApiRestrictData
nodes.summary: Model capturing whether an API restriction rule was triggered, returned by the gateway rate-limiting Lua script.

nodes.name: ApiRestrictCacheOperate.java
nodes.summary: Gateway component that loads the apiLimit.lua rate-limiting script at startup and executes it against Redis for API restriction checks.

nodes.name: ApiRestrictCacheOperate
nodes.summary: Executes the gateway API rate-limit Lua script via RedisCache and parses the JSON result into ApiRestrictData.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: PostConstruct initializer that loads lua/apiLimit.lua from the classpath into a DefaultRedisScript with String result type.

nodes.name: OrderProgramCacheResolutionOperate.java
nodes.summary: Order-service component that loads OrderProgramDataResolution.lua and executes it to reverse/restore program cache data (e.g., on order cancel).

nodes.name: OrderProgramCacheResolutionOperate
nodes.summary: Runs the program cache reversal Lua script through RedisCache to atomically roll back cached program stock data.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: PostConstruct initializer loading lua/OrderProgramDataResolution.lua into a DefaultRedisScript with Integer result type.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller of the program-service exposing ticket category add, detail, and list-by-program endpoints consumed by other services via Feign.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryController
nodes.summary: Spring MVC controller delegating ticket category operations to TicketCategoryService and wrapping results in ApiResponse.

nodes.name: TicketCategoryService.java
nodes.summary: Core service for ticket categories: creation with UID generation, and stock/list reads backed by a Caffeine local cache plus Redis with distributed read locks (cache penetration protection).

nodes.name: TicketCategoryService
nodes.summary: MyBatis-Plus ServiceImpl providing ticket category CRUD and multi-level cached queries guarded by Redisson locks and the @ServiceLock annotation.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Transactionally creates a ticket category after verifying the parent program exists, assigning a distributed UID as primary key.

nodes.name: selectTicketCategoryListByProgramId
nodes.summary: Reads the ticket category list for a program from Redis; on miss, takes a Redisson reentrant lock and loads from MySQL with cache write-back to prevent cache breakdown.

nodes.name: getRedisRemainNumberResolution
nodes.summary: Retrieves remaining-ticket counts from a Redis hash with double-checked locking, falling back to the database and populating the hash on miss.

nodes.name: LocalCacheTicketCategory.java
nodes.summary: Caffeine-based in-JVM local cache for ticket category lists whose entry TTL is aligned with the corresponding Redis key expiration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Caffeine's Expiry interface to derive per-entry TTL from the Redis key's remaining lifetime, keeping local and remote caches consistent.

nodes.name: LocalCacheTicketCategory
nodes.summary: Local cache component storing List<TicketCategoryVo> per program id with configurable maximum size and Redis-synchronized expiration.

nodes.name: localLockCacheInit
nodes.summary: PostConstruct initializer building the Caffeine cache with a custom Expiry that reads each key's TTL from Redis via RedisCache.getExpire.

nodes.name: ProgramCacheCreateOrderResolutionOperate.java
nodes.summary: Program-service component loading programDataCreateOrderResolution.lua and executing it to atomically validate and deduct cached stock during order creation.

nodes.name: ProgramCacheCreateOrderResolutionOperate
nodes.summary: Executes the create-order cache resolution Lua script via RedisCache and parses the JSON result into ProgramCacheCreateOrderData.

nodes.name: ProgramCacheResolutionOperate.java
nodes.summary: Program-service component loading programDataResolution.lua and executing it to update cached program/ticket data atomically in Redis.

nodes.name: ProgramCacheResolutionOperate
nodes.summary: Runs the program data resolution Lua script through RedisCache for atomic cache updates of program stock state.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: PostConstruct initializer loading lua/programDataResolution.lua into a DefaultRedisScript with Integer result type.

nodes.name: ProgramDelCacheData.java
nodes.summary: Program-service component loading programDel.lua and executing it to atomically delete program-related cache keys from Redis.

nodes.name: ProgramDelCacheData
nodes.summary: Executes the program cache deletion Lua script via RedisCache to invalidate program cache entries atomically.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: PostConstruct initializer loading lua/programDel.lua into a DefaultRedisScript with Integer result type.
